code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows mild hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild anemia with increased red cell distribution width. There is a shift in white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, relative neutropenia and lymphopenia), elevated ferritin, mild CRP elevation, and increased INR. Electrolyte disturbances (mild hyperkalemia, hyperchloremia), mild hypoglycemia, and elevated urea are present. Alkaline phosphatase is elevated. Findings suggest possible inflammation/infection, mild liver dysfunction, and coagulopathy; clinical correlation is recommended.
